newsitem.title: UK: UK Peptide sees Phase II oral typhoid in Q3.
newsitem.headline: UK Peptide sees Phase II oral typhoid in Q3.

text.p: Peptide Therapeutics Plc said on Tuesday that it expected its oral vaccine against typhoid to enter Phase II clinical trials in the third quarter of 1997.
In a telephone interview with Reuters, the company's new chief executive John Brown said Peptide also hoped to start clinical trials on an intranasal influenza vaccine at around the same time.
Both drugs are being developed in cooperation with Medeva Plc which announced a strategic alliance on non-injectable vaccines with Peptide last month.
Non-injectable vaccines against the E-coli food poisoning bacteria and tetanus are in pre-clinical trials.
